name: Play
description: Right-pointing triangle

name: Pause
description: Two upright bars, outlined

name: Stop
description: Square

name: Record
description: Solid disc

name: Record (outline)
description: Circle outline (record, unarmed or inactive)

name: Return to zero
description: Vertical bar with a left-pointing triangle

name: Go to end
description: Right-pointing triangle with a vertical bar

name: Rewind
description: Two left-pointing triangles

name: Fast forward
description: Two right-pointing triangles

name: Previous
description: Vertical bar with two left-pointing triangles (previous marker / track)

name: Next
description: Two right-pointing triangles with a vertical bar (next marker / track)

name: Loop
description: Two opposed right-angled arrows forming a closed cycle

name: Punch in
description: Arrow pointing into an opening bracket that holds a record dot

name: Punch out
description: Record dot inside a closing bracket with an arrow leaving it

name: Metronome
description: Tapered metronome body with a base line and a tilted pendulum arm

name: Count in
description: Three beat dots leading into a play triangle

name: Add
description: Plus sign

name: Remove
description: Minus sign

name: Close
description: Diagonal cross

name: Check
description: Check mark

name: Undo
description: Arrow turning back to the left over a U-shaped path

name: Redo
description: Arrow turning forward to the right over a U-shaped path

name: Cut
description: Scissors: two finger rings with crossed blades

name: Copy
description: Two overlapping sheets, the front one whole

name: Paste
description: Clipboard with a clip at the top

name: Delete
description: Waste bin with lid and handle

name: Random
description: Die face showing five pips (randomise)

name: Search
description: Magnifying glass

name: Zoom in
description: Magnifying glass with a plus

name: Zoom out
description: Magnifying glass with a minus

name: Settings
description: Eight-tooth gear with a centre hole

name: Info
description: Circle with a lower-case i

name: Warning
description: Triangle with an exclamation mark

name: Lock
description: Closed padlock

name: Unlock
description: Open padlock with the shackle released on the right

name: Link
description: Two chain-link halves joined by a bar, on the diagonal

name: Unlink
description: Two chain-link halves pulled apart, with break marks, on the diagonal

name: Visible
description: Open eye

name: Hidden
description: Eye struck through

name: Open folder
description: Open folder: tabbed back panel with the front flap tipped forward

name: Save
description: Floppy disk with shutter and label

name: Export
description: Arrow rising out of a tray

name: Import
description: Arrow dropping into a tray

name: Chevron up
description: Upward chevron

name: Chevron down
description: Downward chevron

name: Chevron left
description: Left-pointing chevron

name: Chevron right
description: Right-pointing chevron

name: Menu
description: Three horizontal lines

name: More
description: Three dots in a row

name: MIDI learn
description: Five-pin DIN socket face with its key notch (MIDI learn)

name: Tempo sync
description: Clock face whose rim is a clockwise arrow (sync to tempo / clock)

name: Solo
description: Letter S in a square frame (solo)

name: Mute
description: Letter M in a square frame (mute)

name: Monitor
description: Loudspeaker with two sound-wave arcs

name: Headphones
description: Over-ear headphones: headband arc and two ear cups

name: Microphone
description: Capsule microphone in a U-shaped cradle on a short stand

name: Bypass
description: Signal line that arcs over a processor box instead of passing through it

name: Pre-roll
description: Three lead-in dashes into a play triangle

name: Snap
description: Horseshoe magnet (snap to grid)

name: Takes
description: Three staggered bars (take lanes)

name: Headphones left
description: Headphones with the left cup filled (left channel)

name: Headphones right
description: Headphones with the right cup filled (right channel)

name: Arrangement
description: Blocks laid out on three lanes

name: Piano roll
description: Keyboard strip beside three note bars

name: List
description: Three bullet points with lines (event list)

name: Strip chart
description: Controller bars of different heights on a baseline

name: Drum grid
description: 3 × 3 step grid: three steps lit, the rest as dots

name: Treble clef
description: G clef: stem with a top loop and a spiral round the G line

name: Bass clef
description: F clef: dotted hook curling down, with two dots

name: Envelope
description: Attack, decay, sustain, release line

name: Pointer
description: Arrow pointer (select tool)

name: Pencil
description: Pencil on the diagonal (draw tool)

name: Eraser
description: Eraser block on the diagonal (erase tool)

name: Fermata
description: Arc over a dot (hold)

name: Natural
description: Natural sign: two offset stems joined by two slanted bars

name: Repeat
description: End-repeat barline: two dots, a thin and a thick bar

name: Remove (circled)
description: Minus sign in a circle

name: Expand
description: Arrows pointing up and down away from a line (taller rows)

name: Collapse
description: Arrows pointing down and up toward a line (shorter rows)

name: Alert
description: Exclamation mark in a circle

name: Status dot
description: Small solid dot, smaller than record; give it a semantic status colour

name: Speaker off
description: Loudspeaker with a cross (audio muted)

name: Drive warning
description: Exclamation mark over a disk drive (disk too slow)

name: File missing
description: Page with a folded corner, struck through (media offline)

name: Media pool
description: Box holding a waveform, a sheet behind it

name: Normalize
description: Waveform reaching a ceiling and a floor line

name: Fade in
description: Area under a curve rising from left to right

name: Fade out
description: Area under a curve falling from left to right

name: Mono
description: Loudspeaker cone seen from the front: ring with a solid centre (one channel)

name: Stereo
description: Two overlapping rings (two channels)

name: Power
description: Ring open at the top with a bar through the gap

name: Send
description: Knob ring with an arrow leaving it (send)

name: Effects
description: Four-pointed star (effects)

name: Poly
description: Three filled note heads stacked on one stem (a chord: polyphonic)

name: Mono voice
description: One filled note head on a stem (monophonic)

name: Legato
description: Two stemmed notes at different pitches joined by a slur beneath (legato)

name: Oscillator
description: One cycle of a sine wave (sound source)

name: Filter
description: Low-pass response: flat, then rolling off

name: Shaper
description: S-shaped transfer curve in a frame (waveshaper)

name: Modulation
description: One cycle of a triangle wave (LFO)

name: Reset
description: Anticlockwise arrow round a circle (initialise)

name: Part A
description: Letter A in a square frame

name: Part B
description: Letter B in a square frame

name: Single
description: One box spanning the keyboard (single part)

name: Layer
description: Two full-width boxes stacked one above the other (two parts over the same keys)

name: Split
description: Two boxes side by side (keyboard split)

name: Multi
description: Four boxes in a 2 by 2 grid (multitimbral)
